outcome: reduced APGAR scores at 1 and 5 minutes postpartum
increased likelihood of neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women (from an initial enrollment of 145) with normally progressing pregnancies at term gestation.
finding: An AFI of less than 5 is significantly associated with increased maternal risks such as higher rates of operative delivery, and adverse fetal outcomes including low birth weight, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, low APGAR scores, and an elevated likelihood of NICU admission.
mod_finding: A low AFI was significantly associated with an increased need for cesarean section (LSCS).
followup_time: 5 minutes postpartum (for APGAR scores), and immediate perinatal period (for NICU admission)
birth_weight: N/A (lower birth weight was an outcome)
